description: 企鹅号图文发布流程（v1.8.7：自主声明改用 evaluate_edit标记+Playwright click 点击，修复 MouseEvent isTrusted=false 不触发 React 受控组件 onChange 的问题）

steps.descript: 导航到企鹅号文章编辑页（会加载上次草稿，后续步骤会清空）
等待编辑器加载（标题或正文任一出现即可）
填写标题（fill 会自动替换已有内容）
粘贴正文（先 Ctrl+A+Delete 清空草稿，再剪贴板粘贴 HTML）
检查是否存在AI生成声明提示（有图片时才会出现'进行补充'链接）

branch_steps.value: const links = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=ai__declaration] a')); const link = links.find(a => (a.innerText||'').includes('进行补充')); if (link) { link.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); link.click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'not found';
branch_steps.descript: 点击AI声明'进行补充'链接打开声明弹窗
等待AI声明弹窗的提交按钮出现

branch_steps.value: const dialog = document.querySelector('[class*=aidialog]'); if (!dialog) return 'dialog not found'; const btn = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll('button.omui-button--primary')).find(b => (b.innerText||'').trim() === '提交'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return 'submitted'; } return 'submit button not found';
branch_steps.descript: 点击AI声明弹窗的'提交'按钮
等待AI声明提交完成、弹窗关闭

steps.condition: var bt = document.body.innerText || ''; bt.indexOf('请选择自主声明') >= 0 || bt.indexOf('添加内容自主声明') >= 0 || bt.indexOf('修改声明') >= 0;
steps.descript: v1.8.7 检测是否需要设置自主声明（页面提示'请选择自主声明'或存在'添加内容自主声明/修改声明'按钮）

branch_steps.value: var candidates = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button.omui-button--dashed, button')); var addBtn = candidates.find(function(b) { var t = (b.innerText || '').trim(); return t.indexOf('添加内容自主声明') >= 0 || t === '修改声明' || (t.indexOf('自主声明') >= 0 && t.indexOf('请选择') < 0); }); if (!addBtn) return 'no_add_button'; document.querySelectorAll('[data-publish-target]').forEach(function(el) { el.removeAttribute('data-publish-target'); }); addBtn.setAttribute('data-publish-target', 'open_declaration'); addBtn.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); return 'marked: ' + (addBtn.innerText || '').trim();
branch_steps.descript: v1.8.7 定位并标记'添加内容自主声明'按钮（用data-publish-target属性，供Playwright click定位）
v1.8.7 用Playwright click点击'添加内容自主声明'按钮（真实鼠标事件isTrusted=true触发React onClick，修复MouseEvent isTrusted=false不触发弹窗的问题）
等待自主声明弹窗出现

branch_steps.value: var dialogs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.omui-dialog, [class*=dialog], [role=dialog], .omui-modal, [class*=modal]')).filter(function(d) { return d.offsetParent !== null; }); var dialog = dialogs.find(function(d) { var t = d.innerText || ''; return t.indexOf('声明内容') >= 0 || t.indexOf('取材网络') >= 0 || t.indexOf('无需标注') >= 0 || t.indexOf('自主声明') >= 0; }) || dialogs[0]; if (!dialog) throw new Error('自主声明弹窗未打开'); document.querySelectorAll('[data-publish-target="no_label"]').forEach(function(el) { el.removeAttribute('data-publish-target'); }); var allElements = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll('*')); var noLabel = null; for (var i = 0; i < allElements.length; i++) { var el = allElements[i]; if (el.offsetParent === null && el.tagName !== 'INPUT') continue; var t = (el.innerText || el.value || '').trim(); if (t === '无需标注' || (t.indexOf('无需标注') >= 0 && t.length < 20)) { noLabel = el; break; } } if (!noLabel) throw new Error('弹窗内未找到无需标注选项，弹窗文本前200字: ' + (dialog.innerText || '').slice(0, 200)); var clickTarget = noLabel; for (var p = 0; p < 5; p++) { var parent = noLabel.parentElement; if (!parent || parent === dialog) break; var pt = (parent.innerText || '').trim(); if (pt.indexOf('无需标注') >= 0 && pt.length < 30) { clickTarget = parent; break; } noLabel = parent; } clickTarget.setAttribute('data-publish-target', 'no_label'); clickTarget.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); return 'marked: ' + clickTarget.tagName + ' (text=' + (clickTarget.innerText || '').trim().slice(0, 30) + ')';
branch_steps.descript: v1.8.7 定位并标记'无需标注'选项（用data-publish-target属性，供Playwright click定位）
v1.8.7 用Playwright click点击'无需标注'选项（真实鼠标事件isTrusted=true触发React onChange，修复受控radio/checkbox不响应MouseEvent的问题）

branch_steps.value: var dialogs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.omui-dialog, [class*=dialog], [role=dialog], .omui-modal, [class*=modal]')).filter(function(d) { return d.offsetParent !== null; }); var dialog = dialogs[0]; if (!dialog) throw new Error('自主声明弹窗已关闭，无法点击确认'); document.querySelectorAll('[data-publish-target="confirm"]').forEach(function(el) { el.removeAttribute('data-publish-target'); }); var btn = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll('button')).find(function(b) { var t = (b.innerText || '').trim(); return t === '确认' || t === '确定' || t === '提交'; }); if (!btn) throw new Error('弹窗内未找到确认按钮，弹窗按钮列表: ' + Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll('button')).map(function(b) { return (b.innerText || '').trim(); }).join('|')); btn.setAttribute('data-publish-target', 'confirm'); btn.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); return 'marked_confirm: ' + btn.tagName + ' (text=' + (btn.innerText || '').trim() + ')';
branch_steps.descript: v1.8.7 定位并标记确认按钮（带诊断信息，找不到时返回弹窗内所有按钮文本）
v1.8.7 用Playwright click点击确认按钮提交自主声明（真实鼠标事件触发React表单提交）
v1.8.7 等待自主声明弹窗关闭和状态更新

branch_steps.value: var bodyText = document.body.innerText || ''; if (bodyText.indexOf('请选择自主声明') >= 0) { throw new Error('自主声明设置后页面仍提示"请选择自主声明"，设置未生效（v1.8.7 已用Playwright click真实点击无需标注+确认）'); } return 'declaration_set_ok';

branch_steps.value: var dialog = document.querySelector('[class*=aidialog]') || Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog], .omui-dialog, .omui-modal')).find(d => (d.innerText||'').indexOf('AI生成') >= 0 || (d.innerText||'').indexOf('人工智能生成') >= 0); if (!dialog) return 'dialog not found'; var btn = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll('button.omui-button--primary, button')).find(b => (b.innerText||'').trim() === '提交'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return 'submitted'; } return 'submit button not found';

等待AI声明提交完成、弹窗关闭

steps.value: for (var i = 0; i < 30; i++) { var btns = document.querySelectorAll('button'); var hasPublish = false; for (var j = 0; j < btns.length; j++) { var t = (btns[j].innerText || '').trim(); if (t === '发布' || t === '定时发布') { hasPublish = true; break; } } if (!hasPublish) { return 'publish_btn_disappeared'; } if (window.location.href.indexOf('articleManage') >= 0) { return 'url_changed'; } var toasts = document.querySelectorAll('[class*="toast"], [class*="message"], [class*="notification"], [class*="tip"]'); for (var k = 0; k < toasts.length; k++) { var tt = (toasts[k].innerText || '').trim(); if (tt.indexOf('发布成功') >= 0 || tt.indexOf('已发布') >= 0 || tt.indexOf('提交成功') >= 0) { return 'toast_success: ' + tt.slice(0, 50); } } await new Promise(function(r) { setTimeout(r, 1000); }); } return 'timeout_30s_btn_still_visible';
